notes.title: DanceXR 2025.7 Release
notes.notes: DanceXR 2025.7 introduces a new sky shader with moon and aurora, refined motion curves for smoother movements, and various improvements. For more details, visit https://vrstormlab.com/dancexr/releases/2025.7

notes.title: DanceXR 2025.6 Release
notes.notes: DanceXR 2025.6 introduces a new Discovery App for easy content discovery, improved softbody physics for more realistic movement, fixed dithering options, and other bug fixes. Explore the full release notes at https://vrstormlab.com/dancexr/releases/2025.6.

notes.title: Introducing DanceXR Discovery
notes.notes: [p]We are excited to introduce DanceXR Discovery, a powerful companion app for DanceXR that allows you to easily discover and manage your DanceXR content. [/p][p][/p][p]The DanceXR Discovery app is released as a free DLC, you can download it for free from the DLC page. Once downloaded, use the last launch option that says "DanceXR Discovery" to launch the tool. [/p][p][/p][p]You will need a DeviantArt account and authorize us to browse content and manage favourites on your behalf to use the app.[/p][p][/p][p]You can find featured content and enter your own search to discover new DanceXR assets. Use "More Like This" and "Creator Gallery" to explore related content and find new favorites.[/p]

notes.title: DanceXR 2025.5 Release: Enhanced Graphics & Audio Visualization
notes.notes: DanceXR 2025.5 introduces experimental pathtracing for realistic lighting, posterization effects for artistic visuals, and real-time audio visualization that responds to music. These updates enhance immersion and creativity. Learn more at https://vrstormlab.com/dancexr/releases/2025.5

notes.title: 2024.10 Now Available on Beta
notes.notes:
Animation Performance ImprovementsPermalink
2024.10 update further improves the efficiency of the new motion system introduced several versions ago, now it is capable of animating a great number characters without obvious FPS drop.

In the new version a 7 character group dance runs at stable 100+ fps while the previous version average at 80.

Support for specular & emission mapsPermalink
New option to use specular map for metallic and smoothness values, enhancing visual of materials with metallic parts

Support for XPS emission maps that make certain part of the material glow

Feet Correction With High HeelsPermalink
New multi-point contact solving model that prevents clipping and corrects feet pose dynamically based on collision against ground.

Automatic toe bending on contact with ground.

Adaptive high heels pose

Procedural shoe model that fits perfectly with the contact points and high heel adjustments.

New option in accessory settings to attach external model to the feet.

Reworked First Person CameraPermalink
Works perfectly with the new motion system

Controlling head & hand movements in VR using headset & controller tracking

New auto hand pose for VR hands that uses controller input for hand gesture. You can change hand pose in VR hand settings under system settings.

Define Chorus Sections for the audioPermalink
You can configure chorus section for the audio and use it as data source to drive auto update values.

Other changesPermalink
Mirror now supports VR, you can now feel proper depth of your image in the mirror in VR.

New VR hand model that can interact with cloth simulation & particle dynamics

Settings for currently assigned motions for all characters are now listed together under the motion menu, for easier access.

Default key assignment for toggling UI has been changed to right hand thumbstick click

Fixed VR recording in creator edition

Camera is locked in VR when UI is visible

Cloth simulation and particle dynamics is more stable and smoother under variable frame rate condition.

notes.title: Release 1.4.2 is published on beta branch
notes.notes:
Introducing our new Particle System that can bring your visual effects to life with snow, glitter, rain, and falling leaves. With comprehensive settings, you can control the look and physics of particles, and even load custom textures. Our cloud settings are now fixed and refined, allowing for individual adjustments for a more realistic appearance. We've also improved our shader updates with a procedural detail map for skin and hair, as well as enhanced wetness and rain effects. Our camera options have expanded with new fancam and tracking features for freefly and concert mode. Additionally, our UI and UX have been improved with restored folder structures and clear indications of changed settings. Finally, we've updated our motion system with natural arm bending and a fine-tuning setting for arm bending axis. Experience the full potential of your visual creations with our latest updates.

Full release notes and demo videos can be found here: https://vrstormlab.com/dancexr/releases/1.4.2

Currently available on the beta branch, will roll out to the main branch later this month.
